'''Ku Chusar''' was an [[Artist/Legends|artist]] who made several abstract [[Painting/Legends|paintings]]. He was recognized as one of the most famous artists of his [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="Allies" /> By [[44 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] owned several of Chusar's paintings, which she kept framed in her private apartments on the Alliance's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ku Chusar was mentioned in [[Christie Golden]]'s [[2010]] novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'', the fifth installment in the ''[[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi]]'' series.<ref name="Allies" />
